items.note: Plan gives h, v, N, m, I, both neighbour rules, the eight-row schedule's role, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the bit and complex coefficient checks, the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) and the wire counts, all as in the proof at 741-783.

Frames per vertex, edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the invariant stored = D_v(logical), commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} for every role, matching 804-825.

The terminal labels, stage transitions, the decomposition A(x)F=(B(x)F)+(P(x)F), the full residual table, the single decreasing edge (centre 3->4, loss h), telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, binary orthonormal bases and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all given as in 1012-1110. One slip: S1.3.1 attributes the formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 to the binary field as well (listed under errors); its conclusion is right.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one exceptions 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, as in the proof at 1156-1172.

Weight-mod-4 phase, additivity on orthogonal vectors, one kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, the weight-27 exceptional pair repaired by C=iZC^{-1}Z, giving C^{(x)m} on every role; this is the route of 1231-1315. Tensoring over k columns is stated in S1.3.8.11.

L/N<1/2 gives s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m; the exact deficits eta_b, eta_c, the comparison with 20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly as in 1319-1346.

The plan uses linear-time controlled shifts and cyclic row splitting inside other steps (triangular updates, role streams, rotations, CRT shifts), but no step states either lemma: the list of O(V) digit operations on fixed tapes, or the condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time.

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 by the stated elimination order, choice of the odd prime, O(V) triangular parts by descending updates, and each one of Pi as D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j with one interchange, giving exactly a interchanges, as in 1375-1447.

Splitting rows into W role streams of volume V/W, frames Phi_M with edges Phi_{A_e} done by matrix shear, the endpoint contract giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-step interchange, s calls, the O(V) parking-stack schedule, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and the two-case geometric sum to O(e^tau), as in 1491-1616.

High digits as row field (rho=O(log e), R=q^{2rho}>=W^k), padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces handled by the power-width case, the geometric sum to O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to [q^e], as in 1649-1735; the one-bit-difference case appears only briefly in S6.3.3.

Conjugation by P_M moves residual vectors into coordinate slots, one child (C^{eps})^{(x)f} per residual vector, inverse children from forward ones by (C^{-1})^{(x)f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D, as in 1835-1940.

The eight parity-conditioned additions (two three-cycles), packed as cyclic shifts of whole chunks, correct off the guard-failure set, the bound delta_bad from 20 excluded values per guard, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, repair by radix sort, and the cost and its family simplification, as in 2013-2231.

Rows from the first q_0 chunks, children of volume V/W, node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^beta, internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}), as in 2286-2448.

States the layer returned as Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, evaluated exactly with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) guard bits via A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E; the parameter conditions on lambda' appear in S1.6.4.15 and S1.6.4.7. The proof route (phase frames, row split, packed basis changes, guard widths, disk preservation) matches 2686-2758.

Character cancellation by the shift k->k+t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency stored in bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds H then J_E, the layout L (prefix moves, Dq-1 width-K exchanges), costs per term, and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, as in 2819-3206.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, signed encoding and centered extraction with their carries, reduction mod y^r+1, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, as in 3233-3368.

Two forward transforms in retained LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), signed-packed pointwise products, opposite transform and exact scale by M; the normalization check and the error M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, as in 3414-3495.

Uses T P_s F_s = P_t F_t S, N=CTD with ||N-I||<1/2 inverted by Neumann series, normalizations S', J', D' with product 2^{-2alpha^2}, the error/time table, ordered selection C, and linewise tensoring with axis exposure, as in 3576-3897. The left-inverse step (D N^{-1} C)T=I at 3626-3634 is implicit rather than written out.

Both identities and their proofs (chirp periodicity, coefficient expansion, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, RF^+R=F^+, convolution rule) follow 3938-3983. The lemma's last clause, that conjugation turns an algorithm for RF_s into one for RF_s^+, is not stated anywhere in the plan.
All fixed exponents, sizes, comparison constants, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime-interval lemma, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i>p, and the n^{o(1)} prime search, as in 4004-4179.

Phi is an algebra isomorphism, the triangular mixed-radix formula, updates in order i=d..1 by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts on the valid interval, and axis reversal by O(d^2) chunk swaps costing O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in 4204-4296.

The exact twist, its well-definedness, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are given. The computed sequence (f', g', h', untwist) at 4383-4391 is not written out, but S5.7.5 and S5.7.7 give its phase-product error below 4h_p and the sum of two input twists, ring error and untwist.

Chirp transform, source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A = RF_s, the digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps and the role of the two S factors are as in 4434-4544. Missing: the opposite-sign procedure is used (step 4) but never defined as F~^+(z)=conj(F~(conj z)) (4478-4484).

Error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, 2E_s+2, 3E_s+2, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, final 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries, as in 4546-4806. The step's motivation misdescribes the spare bits (see errors), but the derivation steps are right.

The cost table rows and powers, margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2kappa, the row-by-row justification, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, absorption of log p powers into p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in 4815-4995.

S0 asserts that the bound disproves the Schoenhage-Strassen n log n conjecture in this model, but no step gives the content: the eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n, its negation by liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, and that the power saving gives limit zero.

errors.says: Over F=Q^h (form x^T(I-J/9)y) for the bit network and F=F_2^h (dot product) for the complex one, the triple indicators satisfy <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, <t_T,t_T>=2 holds for the rational form (861-865). For F_2^h with the dot product the paper gives t_T.t_T=1 (867-868); there t_S.t_T=|S cap T| mod 2, so the stated formula would wrongly make t_T.t_T=0 and even-intersection neighbours non-orthogonal. The conclusion (nondegenerate lines, orthogonal neighbours, 869-870) is right.

errors.says: Motivation: the final multiplication by 2^{2b+4}S amplifies the error by at most 2^{2b+4}S*2^{-p}, which stays small only because p=6b leaves 4b spare bits.
errors.paper: The amplification factor is 2^{2b+4}S applied to an error already of size 28*2^gamma T^2 L*2^{-6b}; with S,T<2^b and L<b the result is 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4} (4722-4726), so the effective margin is about b-gamma bits, not 4b.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to end: fixed network, frames, labels, rank and kernel counts with s<Wm, the exponent tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the two recursive tape primitives, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations and chirps, CRT and twist, exact recovery, and the cost table with minimum margin 2kappa. It is thin in only three places: the elementary stream and controlled-shift lemmas are used but never stated; the conjugation definition of the opposite source transform is missing; and the n log n disproof is asserted without its liminf argument. None of these breaks the chain to the main bound.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(h,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by T^3, and the three-stage network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and intermediate frames are free so that edges are cheap (S1.2 motivation).
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{(x)3} (dimension m), comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central 3->4 with loss h are all stated.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges (2P_{U_a}, rank one, zero dimension change) as the only exceptions.
Signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, absolute changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are all given.
L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), hence s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m from P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, giving Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every role and row, including scratch rows.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); the edge Phi_{A_e} is done by recursive interchanges, s calls in all.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) by the two-case geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain: the fixed h=100 bank-exchange network, frames commuting with pointwise gates, nested nondegenerate labels whose only loss is the central 3->4 edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear on every role, edges as exactly rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the explicit tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps carry their defining quantities and play their role in the chain.
